name: Shidou Kazuya
source:
Basically the typical protagonist. He generally finds things a hassle and has strong tendency to slack off. Acts cool, but is actually the caring type who sticks his nose into other people's business. He wants a girlfriend, but definitely enjoys mucking about with his buddies as well. 

His family of four also includes his grandfather [url=/c91599]Genzaburou[/url], his father Ryuuichirou and his mother [url=/c34213]Machiko[/url]. As of late, however, his father has been going offshore fishing frequently, so he is rarely home.

An ill-fated protagonist, for as he a relatively decent person, he finds himself treated as the plaything of his group.

[Translated from [url=http://www.do-game.co.jp/r18/products/%E6%B5%B7%E9%81%93/]the official site[/url]]
